methods.title: Natural History Quiz
methods.description: Use the one-time Varrock Museum quiz to skip the slow opening Hunter levels.

methods.title: Best useful traditional quarry
methods.description: Use the highest practical tracking, butterfly, salamander, falconry, or pitfall quarry available when a specialised route is locked.

methods.title: Bird house runs
methods.description: Add short Fossil Island runs between other activities for low-attention Hunter progress and nests.

methods.title: Novice Hunter Rumours
methods.description: Train actively through varied assignments while building an early sack of Ironman supplies.

methods.title: Adept Hunter Rumours
methods.description: Use the upgraded rumour tier for useful supply sacks and a varied route toward Expert rumours.

methods.title: Expert Hunter Rumours
methods.description: Continue with Expert rumours for strong active XP and broad Ironman resources, including progress toward moths and antelopes.

methods.title: Master Hunter Rumours
methods.description: Use Master rumours when high-level resource variety matters alongside fast Hunter progress.

methods.title: Red chinchompas
methods.description: Bank chinchompas when future Ranged burst training is worth more than general rumour supplies.

methods.title: Sunlight and moonlight antelopes
methods.description: Hunt antelopes when high-healing food and unique crossbow ammunition are immediate account needs.

methods.title: Moonlight moths for prayer mixes
methods.description: Catch moths and combine them with raw hunter meat when renewable prayer restoration is the real target.

methods.title: Wyrmscraig goat hunting
methods.description: Gather goat fur and horns when Sailing access is ready and Golem Crafting or combat-potion inputs are useful.

methods.title: Quest rewards and useful early crafts
methods.description: Use early quest XP, gems, leather, and jewellery to reach the dependable glassblowing band.

methods.title: Banked gems and useful jewellery
methods.description: Cut gems and make jewellery when the outputs solve teleport, bolt-tip, or alchemy needs.

methods.title: Early glassblowing
methods.description: Buy or gather sand and seaweed, smelt molten glass, and blow the highest useful glass item before Superglass Make.
acquisitionSources: Bert after The Hand in the Sand

methods.title: Giant seaweed, sandstone, and Superglass Make
methods.description: Build the classic renewable glass chain, then blow the highest useful glass product.
acquisitionSources: Giant seaweed runs on Fossil Island
Sandstone at the Bandit Camp Quarry

methods.title: Sunstone Golem Crafting
methods.description: Mine sunstone, sculpt golems, and clothe them with Hunter furs as a modern active alternative to bulk glass.
recommendedRequirements: A stock of Hunter furs; higher-tier furs improve total XP
acquisitionSources: Hunter Rumours and traditional fur hunting

methods.title: Battlestaves from banked orbs
methods.description: Charge and attach orbs when the account values Crafting XP and high-alchemy cash together.

methods.title: Banked dragonhide bodies
methods.description: Process hides already earned from combat when the alchemy return and fast bank-standing XP are both useful.

methods.title: Quest rewards, diaries, and fossils
methods.description: Front-load guaranteed XP rewards before consuming scarce herbs, especially through the early and lower-mid levels.

methods.title: Process banked herbs into useful potions
methods.description: Make the potions the account will actually use before gathering more ingredients only for XP.

methods.title: Prayer potions from ranarr and snape grass
methods.description: Prioritise prayer potions when Slayer or PvM supply readiness matters more than raw Herblore speed.
acquisitionSources: Ranarr: Farming Contracts, Master Farmers, Slayer and PvM
Snape grass: allotment farming from 61 Farming
Small emergency amounts from ground spawns

methods.title: Mastering Mixology
methods.description: Spend herbs at the Alchemical Society when XP per herb and permanent utility rewards outweigh immediate potion output.
consumes: Herbs converted to mox, aga, and lye paste

methods.title: Herb runs and Farming Contracts
methods.description: Use contracts to sustain seeds, then turn those seeds into herbs through consistent protected runs.
acquisitionSources: Master Farmers when Thieving and Farming are ready

methods.title: Slayer, PvM, and Hunter supply loop
methods.description: Let useful combat and Hunter progression supply herbs, seeds, nests, and secondaries instead of grinding each input in isolation.

methods.title: Regular planks and early quest XP
methods.description: Use gathered regular planks and early account rewards to establish the workshop without over-investing GP.
acquisitionSources: Barbarian Outpost or Port Khazard plank spawns

methods.title: Crafting table 1s
methods.description: Build and remove Crafting table 1s for a material-conscious bridge into oak furniture.

methods.title: Oak larders
methods.description: Use oak planks for a straightforward fast route when GP and gathered oak logs are available.

methods.title: Beginner Mahogany Homes
methods.description: Use beginner contracts when conserving each regular plank matters more than peak speed.

methods.title: Novice Mahogany Homes
methods.description: Stretch oak planks through contracts while earning the plank sack and other contract rewards.

methods.title: Adept Mahogany Homes with teak planks
methods.description: Convert teak planks efficiently through contracts for a balanced midgame POH route.
costs: 500 coins per teak plank plus travel supplies
acquisitionSources: Fossil Island or Avium Savannah teaks

methods.title: Expert Mahogany Homes
methods.description: Use mahogany contracts when plank efficiency is worth the higher conversion cost on the route to major POH unlocks.
costs: 1,500 coins per mahogany plank plus travel supplies
acquisitionSources: Fossil Island or Avium Savannah hardwood patches

methods.title: Mounted mythical capes
methods.description: Use the mythical cape's bonus teak-plank XP when Dragon Slayer II is complete and speed matters.

methods.title: Teak garden benches
methods.description: Spend teak planks quickly in the Superior Garden when active training speed is the priority.

methods.title: Mahogany tables
methods.description: Trade a large GP and plank cost for very fast active Construction XP.

methods.title: Passive Wintertodt repairs
methods.description: Take free incidental Construction XP while pursuing Firemaking rather than treating it as a primary 99 route.

methods.title: Natural History Quiz
methods.description: Use the museum quiz for the first 1,000 Slayer XP before taking low-level assignments.

methods.title: Useful tasks from the best practical master
methods.description: Complete tasks that advance combat, points, herbs, seeds, coins, prayer supplies, and gear rather than chasing XP alone.
recommendedRequirements: Build combat through quests before committing to a long Slayer grind
Use the highest practical Slayer master

methods.title: Konar milestone tasks
methods.description: Use Konar on valuable streak milestones for extra points and brimstone keys when location restrictions are acceptable.
recommendedRequirements: Plan milestone tasks around the current streak

methods.title: Duradel or Kuradal task list
methods.description: Use the high-level task list for a strong mix of XP, points, and Ironman drops once access is ready.
recommendedRequirements: 100 combat, unless bypassed by a Slayer cape

methods.title: Burst dust devil tasks
methods.description: Use Ancient Magicks on stacked dust devils for fast Slayer and Magic progress while banking alchables.

methods.title: Burst or barrage greater nechryael
methods.description: Stack greater nechryael for high Slayer and Magic XP when rune supply is healthy; melee normal nechryael when herb seeds matter more.

methods.title: Barrage smoke devil tasks
methods.description: Use high-intensity stacked smoke devils for top-end Slayer XP once the level and rune supply are ready.
costs: Optional cannonballs only when efficient for the account

methods.title: Melee herb-and-seed tasks
methods.description: Choose aberrant spectres, kurasks, and normal nechryael when Herblore inputs are the account bottleneck.

methods.title: Mortimer's Wyrmscraig tasks
methods.description: Use the modern high-level task list after Fallen From Grace when its Wyrmscraig assignments and rewards fit the account.
